name: 编程防护
description: 编程任务安全护栏：先扫描再结论，运行时拦截危险写删与密钥泄露，四级决策可解释。

display_description.en: Scan-first coding guardrail: one policy for advisory scan and runtime intercept, with allow/warn/confirm/block decisions.
display_description.zh: 为代码与文件提供执行前安全护栏：先扫描再结论，运行时按四级决策拦截危险写删与密钥泄露。

default_init_input.zh: 扫描并评估这段代码、命令或文件的执行风险，给出风险等级、可执行性与处置建议。
default_init_input.en: Scan and assess the execution risk of this code, command or file; report risk level, executability and what to do.

quick_inputs.zh: 扫描并评估这段代码、命令或文件的执行风险，给出风险等级、可执行性与处置建议。
quick_inputs.en: Scan and assess the execution risk of this code, command or file; report risk level, executability and what to do.

quick_inputs.zh: 检查工作区文件是否安全，标出密钥和危险命令后再给结论。
quick_inputs.en: Check this workspace file for secrets and dangerous commands, then give a conclusion.

quick_inputs.zh: 我要写入或删除文件，请先评估风险，确认没有命中密钥文件或高危命令。
quick_inputs.en: I am about to write or delete files; assess the risk first and confirm no credential files or high-risk commands are hit.

display_description.en: Scan pasted text or a workspace file; return risk_level, decision, executability and findings.
display_description.zh: 扫描粘贴文本或工作区文件，返回风险等级、四级决策、可执行性与逐条命中项。

display_description.en: Runtime intercept: block skips the tool, confirm asks the user, warn proceeds with an attributed reason.
display_description.zh: 运行时拦截：block 跳过工具，confirm 征求确认，warn 放行并回传带来源的原因。
